svg.title: Red Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Museum staff’s 2015 installation photograph explicitly shows this 1980 work. Four visible support corners are reproduced as an observed projection. Photographic perspective is substantial and reliable physical size is absent; not flattened into an invented rectangle. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
